answer.reason: In the EIA Alabama Electricity Profile 2024 Table 1, the net generation for electric utilities is 38,006,420 megawatthours. The larger figure, 104,914,796 megawatthours, represents total net generation across all sectors rather than electric utilities alone.

B. 104,914,796 megawatthours

Source citation: Alabama Electricity Profile 2024 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/state/alabama/index.php)

Supplied draft answer: B
